name: TextBox 5
text:
Hypotheses
H1  GLP‑1 Weight Loss is associated with greater percentage loss than Coaching Only after baseline-weight adjustment.
H2  Greater repeatable engagement is associated with greater percentage loss.
H3  Greater module completion is associated with greater percentage loss.

Two-occasion log-weight trajectory
log(weight) ~ time + member type
Marginal GLS with compound-symmetry correlation; baseline = 0 and follow-up = 1. The prespecified candidate assumes a common time effect.

Percentage-loss regression
percentage loss ~ baseline weight + member type
Baseline-adjusted percentage-point contrast; predictions were converted back to raw follow-up weight.
